test-case.name: upd-switch-expr-001
test-case.description: Evaluation of an updating switch expression.
test-case.test:
<a/> transform with {
           switch (1)
             case 1 return insert node <b/> into .
             default return insert node <c/> into .
         }

test-case.name: upd-switch-expr-004
test-case.description: Evaluation of an updating switch expression.
test-case.test: transform with { for $node in * return switch (name($node)) case 'b' return delete node $node case 'c' case 'd' return rename node $node as 'x' default return () }

test-case.name: upd-switch-expr-005
test-case.description: Evaluation of an updating switch expression.
test-case.test:
<a n="2"/> transform with {
           switch (@n)
             case '1' return ()
             case '2' return replace value of node @n with 3
             default return delete node @n
         }
